raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely fixed on Meir Teper as “the producer of Mistress” from a single snippet and then tunneled on checking his Godfather credits. They failed to enumerate all producers/executive producers of Mistress (1992) and to consider Robert De Niro, who is associated as a producer on the film and played Vito Corleone in The Godfather (Part II). This misinterpretation and lack of disambiguation led the search down a dead end and away from the correct answer, Vito Corleone.
